translation: Non-toxic. It mainly treats deafness and abscesses and sores, warms the intestines and stomach, stops excessive urination, and treats damp bi [濕痹] of the four limbs that cannot bend or extend, and warm malaria [溫瘧] in children with unresolved accumulation of the body; it can be made into a bath decoction. Taken over a long time, it sharpens the ears and brightens the eyes, boosts the mind and wisdom, and raises the will without aging.
